master.notes: Check only — GP is calculated Rev−COGS
Fallback if combined SG&A blank (ticker resilience)
Reported IS D&A when separately disclosed. MEMO only — embedded in COGS/SG&A/R&D, not additive to EBIT.
Stored positive in Raw_IS; negated in engine output
Net other; engine nets out interest to avoid double count
Ties with generalAndAdministrativeExpenses (P2): when combined SG&A is missing, S&M + G&A both activate and sum. AAPL unaffected (combined is P1 active).

Fallback when totalOtherIncomeExpensesNet is missing. Caveat: engine nets out Interest Income/Expense from this line; this field already excludes interest, so verify if both interest fields have data.

Cross-check only — engine derives Other OpEx as GP − SG&A − R&D − OpInc(reported), falling back to OpEx(reported) − SG&A − R&D when OpInc is missing. Captures operating charges FMP omits from operatingExpenses (TXN/QCOM/STX/MRVL pattern) with no per-ticker reclass. Total/Check keeps this field out of SUMIFS detail builds; no double count.
Basic weighted-avg shares; reference line, never summed into $ subtotals
Check only — reconcile vs built EBITDA (EBIT + D&A)
Dormant fallback synonym for netIncome (check uses netIncome P1)
Check only — discontinued-ops flag vs total Net Income
Check only — discontinued-ops line; reconciles built NI vs reported when present. Not summed (Total/Check).
Pre-NCI consolidated net income - matches our computed pretax - tax

P1 tie with otherCurrentAssets (both sum). FMP switches between the two fields by year (e.g., NVDA: prepaids FY2017-22, otherCurrentAssets FY2023-26); a lower priority here gets shadowed and drops the data.

Aggregate (GW + intangibles) — must NOT back up the Intangibles line: when goodwill is mapped separately and intangibles are 0 (e.g., WMT), activating this double-counts goodwill. Total/Check keeps it visible without summing.
FMP income taxes payable (current); captured as real field. Included in current liab only when <= pre-tax imbalance (see reconciliation block).
Ties with accountsReceivables (P2): when netReceivables is missing, both activate and sum. Verified AAPL netReceivables = accountsReceivables + otherReceivables all years.

Additive at Priority 1 tie with accountPayables (both sum). FMP sometimes reports otherPayables outside its own CL decomposition (AAPL FY2025, NVDA FY2025-26); this row completes the sum. Where taxPayables duplicates otherPayables, the fits test (row 253) auto-drops the tax line — no double count. Note: AP line now = trade + other payables; affects DPO/payables days.

P1 tie with AOCI — FMP catch-all 'other equity' (e.g., AVGO FY2016-18 partnership-era adjustment of −$19-23B). No dedicated Other Equity line; AOCI is the closest bucket. Any double-count surfaces visibly in the balance check.
P1 tie — preferred stock bundled into share capital (no dedicated preferred line in the model; typically immaterial, e.g., AVGO FY2019-21 $27-29M).
Check only — reported total debt (ST + LT + leases); cross-check for valuation debt bridge. Not summed (Total/Check).
Check only — reported net debt (total debt − cash); valuation reference. Not summed (Total/Check).
